newsitem.title: UK: Saudi tells OPEC June output 8.0 mln bpd - OPECNA.
newsitem.headline: Saudi tells OPEC June output 8.0 mln bpd - OPECNA.

text.p: Saudi Arabia told OPEC its production and supply in June was in line with its quota, the OPEC News Agency (OPECNA) said on Tuesday.
Saudi Arabia told OPEC it produced 8.007 million barrels per day (bpd) in June, supplying exactly 8.0 million bpd to the market.
Venezuela told the group's Vienna headquarters it pumped 2.415 million bpd in June, above its 2.359 million bpd allocation.
Qatar told OPEC it produced 0.387 million bpd in June and supplied 0.379 million bpd to the market, just a fraction above its quota.
